test_image_processor_properties: test the BridgeTowerImageProcessingTest to verify image processor properties like image_mean and do_resize exist
test_backends_equivalence: test the BridgeTowerImageProcessingTest backends equivalence by comparing pixel values across different image processing backends
test_slow_fast_equivalence_batched: test the BridgeTowerImageProcessingTest slow and fast processor equivalence on batched image inputs
prepare_image_processor_dict: create a BridgeTowerImageProcessingTester and call prepare_image_processor_dict to get the image processor configuration dictionary
prepare_image_inputs: create a BridgeTowerImageProcessingTester and call prepare_image_inputs to generate dummy image tensors for testing
